headline: PUBG: How the battle royale began
title: PUBG Facts | Brendan Greene Story | Classic Games
video_script: PUBG, now called PUBG Battlegrounds, launched in twenty seventeen and is published by Krafton. It was inspired by the Japanese film Battle Royale from the year two thousand. Its creator Brendan Greene, known as PlayerUnknown, first worked on battle royale mods, including one for Arma two. Players parachute onto an island and the safe zone keeps shrinking. Solo, duo or squad? Comment below!
description: PUBG: Battlegrounds (2017, Krafton): inspired by the film Battle Royale, created by Brendan Greene (PlayerUnknown) after his Arma 2 mods. Sources: Wikipedia, PC Gamer.
